text:
Mira: Quick thread — proposing a 'safety-bump' rollout for the new routing policy. TL;DR: seed tiny cohort -> safety bump -> small A/B split -> staged regional warmup -> fast fallback and rollback breadcrumbs.
Sam: +1. We need concrete flag names, exact bucket percentages, and the circuit-breaker thresholds.
Jas: Circuit breaker conditions I want: p95 latency > 500ms for 5m OR errors > 0.5% over 5m -> immediate fallback to baseline variant. Also an alerted incident and automatic traffic drain.
Mira: Sounds right. Manual kill-chain must be available (product + oncall). Also include automated rollback breadcrumbs in the audit log so we can replay decisions.
Sam: Draft flag payload (for ff-service):
```json
{
  "flag": "routing.enable_new_policy",
  "phase_buckets": [
    {"name":"seed","pct":0.001},
    {"name":"safety_bump","pct":0.009},
    {"name":"experiment","pct":0.04},
    {"name":"control","pct":0.95}
  ],
  "regions": ["us-west1","us-east1","eu-west1"],
  "tenancy": "tenant-opt-in"
}
```
Sam: Example rollout command: `ffctl rollout --flag routing.enable_new_policy --to 0.01 --cohort safety_bump --meta "owner=mira"`
Leo: For enterprise customers we should default to tenant whitelist (opt-in). Any tenant on the whitelist gets routed into the seed cohort only with explicit consent.
Anya: Measurement plan for A/B: 1) infra.latency.p95 delta, 2) api.error.rate, 3) token-cost-per-request, 4) quality-bucket (human eval sample), 5) upstream downstream regression checks. Need to define thresholds for each.
Jas: Metric names we will use: `infra.latency.p95`, `api.errors.rate`, `model.quality.sample_pass_rate`, `cost.tokens.per_request`. Alerts: create pager when error rate > 0.5% sustained 5m, or p95 delta > +150ms vs baseline.
Mira: Launch criteria checklist (short):
- Seed 0.1% for 24h with zero critical alerts
- Safety bump to 1% for 48h with stable metrics
- Expand to 5% A/B for 72h, run quality evals (n=500 samples)
- Regional warmup: mirror to eu region and watch for infra anomalies 24h
- No P0 regressions and token-cost impact < 7% before full ramp
Sam: Rollback plan: automatic fallback via circuit breaker, plus a manual rollback button in Console that records who triggered it and why (breadcrumb). Postmortem template created if rollback happens.
Mira: Deployment timeline proposal: Monday seed, Wednesday safety bump (if green), next Monday start A/B. Exceptions: if any alert fires at any step -> pause and investigate.
Sam: Small engineering note: KV-cache warming required for warmup. We should tag requests in seed so warmers can pre-populate.
Jas: Add SLO guardrail in CloudRouter: `if traffic_drop_rate > 2% after switch for 10m -> revert`. Also ensure circuit-breaker metrics are replicated to the metrics cluster for redundancy.
Leo: Communication plan: send an email to impacted customers with opt-in instructions and set a slack channel #prod-rollout-routing for live updates.
Mira: Can someone own the playbook writeup and the Console button? I can own the playbook, Sam can own the Console control.
Sam: I'll add the flag config, ffctl commands, and integration test in a tiny PR today.
Dev-bot: NOTE: When rollout starts I will post automated status every 10m to #prod-rollout-routing and create incidents on breaker triggers.
Anya: I'll prepare the evalset and run pre-launch baseline sampling by Friday.
Mira: OK — I'll capture all this into a short playbook and link in the channel. If no objections, we start seed next Monday. :thumbsup:
Sam: :+1:
Jas: :thumbsup:
Leo: :rocket:
Mira: Thanks everyone — will post the playbook link once done and pin it to #product.
